scope: private GloshIA Visual training and evaluation
decision_unit: only pixels visible in the exact model input view

presentation_rule.female_visual_presentation: apply female clothing and exposure signals from approximately age 5 or age uncertain
presentation_rule.male_visual_presentation: do not apply female clothing and exposure signals
presentation_rule.identity_inference: visual presentation only; do not infer identity or external context

neckline_rule: a neckline can filter without being large or deep; an ordinary closed neckline remains allow
uncertainty_rule: if a potentially relevant person is visible but the thumbnail is not clear enough to evaluate safely, filter
view_consistency: full images and thumbnails use the same visual rules; a crop may receive a different decision only when it changes the visible facts

review_actions.doubt: exclude from training and binary evaluation
